gold.title: Request payload typed `any` where the sibling handlers type theirs with a named interface
gold.description: users.ts and orders.ts each declare a payload interface (UserPayload, OrderPayload) and read req.body through it. refunds.ts types the same kind of value `any`, so orderId and amountCents are unchecked. Declare RefundPayload { orderId: string; amountCents: number } and use it.

candidate.title: `any` payload where both sibling handlers declare a typed interface
candidate.description: Baseline: `src/api/orders.ts:3-6` declares `interface OrderPayload { sku: string; quantity: number }` and casts at `orders.ts:9`; `src/api/users.ts:3-6` declares `interface UserPayload { email: string; displayName: string }` and casts at `users.ts:9`. `grep -rn "any" src` returns exactly one hit — the added line — so the repo has no competing `any` idiom. Fix: mirror the siblings by declaring `interface RefundPayload { orderId: string; amountCents: number; }` and casting `const payload = req.body as RefundPayload;`
